providers.name: ImportSettingsReader
providers.rule: unset remains unset; Downloads is presentation suggestion only and source-family inboxes are never silently substituted for each other

providers.name: ReferenceMatcher
providers.rule: pure governed matching only; UNIQUE_CANDIDATE is review evidence, AMBIGUOUS remains ambiguous and matching never mutates/merges

providers.name: CustomerAccountCodeReviewService
providers.rule: multiple active reviewed claimants remain ambiguous; exact account code evidence is never silently resolved by descriptive label

providers.name: ServiceRequestImportReader
providers.rule: general base token covers SR projection/reference freshness; source_presence_base_token is SOMA_SR_SOURCE_PRESENCE_BASE_V1 and additionally binds exact current LLD-03 presence-chain head for disappearance review

providers.name: ServiceRequestImportMutationService
providers.contract: LLD-04 supplies one outer command receipt/UnitOfWork and exact immutable proposal/source evidence. LLD-03 revalidates and writes only its owned SR projection/reference/presence-history tables; it invokes LLD-02/06 participants as required and never commits or inserts a second receipt. Current Handler text changes only through accepted source projection; Contact reference can only resolve the exact current source observation and creates no competing handler string. Source disappearance/reappearance changes only the LLD-03 source-presence warning lifecycle.

providers.name: SrSourceEvidenceProvider
providers.rule: resolves exact source_observation_fields -> source_observations -> published advanced_search_sr run and proves canonical SR identity, field key, typed value/value-state and profile/vocabulary authority

providers.name: SrSourcePresenceEvidenceProvider
providers.rule: population-level validation only. Disappearance proves the exact pending population_absence proposal and prior canonical SR observation; reappearance proves one exact conflict-free canonical SR observation in the exact published Advanced Search run. It accepts no source field value and mutates nothing.

providers.name: RfcImportReader
providers.rule: authoritative acceptance re-reads using the caller UnitOfWork

providers.name: RfcImportMutationService
providers.contract: one outer LLD-04 receipt/UoW; terminal source projection may create terminal epoch plus pending cascade proposal but never executes the cascade

providers.name: RfcSourceEvidenceProvider
providers.rule: LLD-04 owns immutable published RFC source evidence and source vocabulary/precedence; LLD-03 owns accepted RFC projection. has_accepted_source_provenance is read-only and uses one exact predicate for stable hard-delete preview snapshots and current writer read contexts.

providers.name: WfmImportReader
providers.rule: source/task planning context is read-only to LLD-04; RETIRED is immutable nonreuse authority and never an ABSENT/create-adopt target; Objective membership/lifecycle remain LLD-05 authority

providers.name: WfmImportMutationService
providers.contract: one outer LLD-04 receipt/UoW; source projection never silently changes execution/outcome/Objective membership and reviewed operational-plan adoption appends a Task-plan revision only

providers.name: ServiceRequestCustomerClassificationParticipant
providers.owner: LLD-06 consumed through LLD-03 Customer mutation
providers.rule: canonical Customer change invalidates incompatible current CPL classification with history and never silently remaps

providers.name: AuditWriter
providers.method: append registered LLD-04 audit action inside caller UnitOfWork

providers.name: DurableJobCoordinator
methods: enqueue/coalesce/cancel/recover ticket_import.source_check and ticket_import.sr_reappearance_reconcile using jobs/import-jobs.json

providers.name: UnitOfWorkFactory
providers.method: open authoritative command UnitOfWork with COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 idempotency

cross_packet_rules: LLD-04 owns source discovery/profile interpretation, immutable import evidence, reconciliation proposals/dispositions, source-family checkpoints and recovery review evidence.
LLD-04 never writes Customer/Contact/SR/RFC/WFM/Task/SLA owner tables directly; accepted proposals and automatic SR reappearance cross only the named owner interfaces above.

Canonical SR Customer and SR Contact relationship history are LLD-03 authority referencing LLD-02 master identities; Current Handler remains LLD-04 source evidence projected through LLD-03 and a Contact link is only identity resolution of the exact current observation.

LLD-03 owns reviewed Advanced Search SR source-presence warning history. LLD-04 keeps absence/reappearance source evidence and validates it through SrSourcePresenceEvidenceProvider; no source field is accepted merely by a presence transition.
All participant mutations execute inside the caller's one LLD-01 UnitOfWork/receipt and return immutable result refs; nested commits/receipts are forbidden.

RfcSourceEvidenceProvider.has_accepted_source_provenance is a read-only cross-packet reader for stable RFC hard-delete preview and commit-time revalidation; no second source-provenance predicate is introduced.

WFM Task No classification is owner-authoritative: ACTIVE resolves current identity, RETIRED produces a blocked identity finding and no create/adopt/source/plan mutation proposal, and ABSENT alone may enter create/adopt review.
No parser or runtime workbook content can register a new mutation kind/provider dynamically.
